scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write web/src web/index.html scripts/*.mjs tests vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check web/src web/index.html scripts/*.mjs tests vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.verify: cargo test --workspace && npm run build && npm run fixture && npm test
